items.title: Staff recommends a motion to consider: A) approval of an Interlocal Agreement between Palm Beach County and the Village of Palm Springs; and B) adoption of a resolution of the Board of County Commissioners of Palm Beach County, Florida, delegating the exercise of powers conferred by Chapter 163, Part III, Florida Statutes, “The Community Redevelopment Act of 1969" to the Village Council of the Village of Palm Springs, with the conditions outlined in the Interlocal

source_note: Items and titles transcribed from the official agenda (table of contents or order of business). Agendas list what was scheduled, not what was decided; votes are not in agendas.
